answer: Found 6 major anti-pattern clusters: (1) jax.lax.switch-based routing in __call__ dispatching 3 decoding approaches; (2) Unused parameters enforced by switch signature; (3) Conditional variant selection in __init__ (encoder type); (4) Multistate mode routing with nested if/elif chains; (5) Deprecated method aliases masking real logic; (6) Direct stage invocation bypassing Executor pattern. Estimated ~400 LOC refactoring across three files.

items.why_relevant: Anti-pattern 1.6: match/switch dispatches on string tags; violates protocol §2.4 (stages should route via Executor, not string branches in __call__)
Anti-pattern 1.6 (if/elif chains): Three-way string dispatch on decoding_approach; not JAX-traceable; should be isolated to StageSet
